name: Gan Assurances
verdict: Gan Assurances is a subsidiary of the Groupama group. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: major partner of FDJ United-Suez since June 2025 (logo on the sleeves and right chest of the jersey for three seasons, per the club communiqué). The owner is the Groupama group, which groupama.com presents as a mutualist group ('Un groupe mutualiste') whose operational activities are piloted by Groupama Assurances Mutuelles; no state or fund owner identified in the chain.
